lastResponse.text: That makes sense. I can’t promise any system is zero-risk, but you can keep control of your info. Share only what’s required, and ask first: “Who can access my data, how long is it kept, and can I get help without uploading this?” You can also say, “I only want to provide the minimum needed.” If they can’t answer clearly, you can pause and choose a different provider.
slottedCanonicalQueryTemplates: I do want the help, I just need to know my data won’t get passed around.
